subject: SparkLine discovery — product fit & SDK changes (post-call)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodai.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit@sparkline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: SparkLine discovery — product fit & SDK changes (post-call)

Hi Amit / Nina —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side to make sure we captured the priorities and next steps: 

Pain points you described:
- Inference costs scaling quickly for re-rank and embed-heavy flows (10–12M tokens / mo projected).
- Tight latency SLOs for live agent assist (p90 < 250ms).
- Need structured, deterministic outputs for downstream billing and audit logs.

What we proposed that maps to those pain points:
- Embed + rerank hybrid: embeddings for coarse recall, short-list with a lightweight re-ranker model (quantized) hosted on Dedicated capacity.
- Streaming + early-stop heuristics to keep p90 under 250ms while preserving quality.
- Structured output + function calling to return canonical JSON for billing and downstream consumers.

Technical items we flagged for follow-up:
1) SDK changes: we suggested small client-side changes for streaming + function-calls (we can provide a reference patch).
2) KV caching: prefilling common prefixes for agent prompts to reduce token count.
3) Model variants: recommend Redwood-quantized-3B for rerank, R-8k for streaming generation.

Attachments: I attached a short PDF that sketches the SDK call pattern and mapping to your flows (redwood-sparkline-sdk-changes-v1.pdf). Also attached a sample prompt set we can use for evals.

Next steps / owners: 
- Redwood: share a thin SDK patch + small demo repo (Priyom, by Tue 8/4).
- SparkLine: share a sample of production prompts and PII constraints (Amit/Nina).
- Follow-up call to review eval results and latency targets (Ben to propose times).

If that matches your notes, I’ll spin up the demo repo and we’ll aim to have an initial eval by next week.

Thanks —
Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SparkLine discovery — product fit & SDK changes (post-call)

Thanks Priyom — that’s helpful and accurate. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- Volume: the 10–12M tokens you called out is current projection; if caching works we could see 30% token reduction.
- Data residency: we need to validate that logs for EU customers are stored in EU regions. Can you confirm Redwood Private / Dedicated supports region pinning?
- Security: our security team will request SOC2 evidence and an encryption summary (KMS/HSM).

We’ll share a representative prompt dump (anonymized) by EOD Monday. Also: can you include a sample structured schema for the function-call payloads so our billing team can validate fields?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to join the follow-up call with our infra lead (Nina).

—Amit
Head of Product
SparkLine

I’ve attached the SOC2 checklist and the sample schema PDF. Also: I spun up a tiny demo repo showing the streaming + function-call pattern — link below.
